JSON Import Guide

Basic Structure

Your JSON file must contain a root sections object. Use the Section Title as the key.

{ "sections": { "My Section Title": { "author": "Jane Smith", "questions": [ ... ] } } }

Question Object

You can provide simple lists or advanced randomization.

{ "variants": [ "What is the unit X?", "Select the correct unit X." ], "options": [ ["Sievert", "Sv"], "Gray", "Rem" ], "correct": "Sv", "explanation": "The Sievert is the SI unit...", "reward": 2 }

Advanced Sample (Full)

A complete example with 3 questions split across 2 sections.

{ "sections": { "Units & Definitions": { "author": "Dr. A. Becquerel", "questions": [ { "question": "What is the SI unit for Activity?", "options": ["Becquerel", "Gray", "Sievert"], "correct": "Becquerel", "reward": 1 }, { "variants": [ "Select the Dose Equivalent unit.", "Which unit represents Dose Equivalent?" ], "options": [ ["Sievert", "Sv"], "Gray", "Rad" ], "correct": "Sv", "explanation": "Sv is the SI unit for dose equivalent.", "reward": 2 } ] }, "Emergency Procedures": { "author": "Health Physics Dept.", "questions": [ { "question": "What is the first priority in a radiological emergency?", "options": ["Protect People", "Contain Spill", "Notify RSO"], "correct": "Protect People", "reward": 1 } ] } } }
